newsitem.title: CHINA: China bans import of Dutch pork, beef, German pork.
newsitem.headline: China bans import of Dutch pork, beef, German pork.

text.p: China has banned the import of pork from Germany as well as pork and beef from the Netherlands because of fears of hog cholera and mad cow disease, the Xinhua news agency said on Wednesday.
The Ministry of Agriculture had recently ordered the ban in order to protect Chinese livestock from infection, Xinhua quoted the State Adminstration of Animal and Plant Quarantine, as saying.
The ban covered imports of German and Dutch pork and pork products and prohibited the posting or carrying of such items into China, Xinhua said.
Dutch cows, cow embryos, beef, beef products and animal feed made from ground cow bones and other livestock would be banned as well, the agency said.
The measures were being taken to protect Chinese livestock from possible contamination from hog cholera, which had broken out in Germany in January and in the Netherlands in February, it said.
Mad cow disease had also broken out in the Netherlands in February and authorities wanted to guard against the possibilty of the sickness spreading to humans, it said without giving further details.
